announcements.title: SOCFortress File Analysis: know what a file does before it runs
announcements.summary: Inspect suspicious files from CoPilot alerts and Velociraptor collections and get a clean, suspicious or malicious verdict.
announcements.body_markdown:
**SOCFortress File Analysis** brings safe file inspection and detonation to CoPilot. Pull a suspicious file straight from an alert or a Velociraptor collection, with no manual download or re-upload, and get a verdict on the alert.

- **Static Inspector (always on)**: parses files without running them, in a network-isolated, locked-down container. It renders document previews, unwraps obfuscated scripts and extracts macros, embedded objects, URLs, IPs, domains and hashes as IoCs.
- **Full Detonation (opt-in)**: runs samples in a full guest VM through CAPE and records process trees, dropped files, persistence, API calls and network activity on an isolated network.
- **Reputation enrichment**: SOCFortress Threat Intel first, then VirusTotal and abuse.ch, using hashes and IoCs only.
- **Built for MSSPs**: results cached by SHA256, every submission scoped to its customer, and file content stays on your own infrastructure by default.

[Watch the demo](https://youtu.be/9zJcj5USMzY): analyze suspicious files without running them, with CoPilot + Velociraptor. [Learn more](https://www.socfortress.co/products/file-analysis).

announcements.title: SOCFortress Signals: more signals, less noise
announcements.summary: Security intelligence matched to the technologies you use, so your team can focus on what matters.
announcements.body_markdown:
**SOCFortress Signals** connects security intelligence to your environment.

- **See the bigger picture**: search advisories, vulnerabilities, threat actors, malware and indicators in one place, with the original sources.
- **Make intelligence readable**: weekly intelligence reports and monthly Patch Tuesday PDFs, by email and in your report archive.
- **Find your signal**: match advisories to your declared products and versions, with evidence-backed explanations and timely alerts.

Global intelligence is available on every plan, including Free.

announcements.title: The SOCFortress WAF
announcements.summary: A self-hosted web application firewall on Caddy + Coraza (OWASP CRS v4), managed from CoPilot.
announcements.body_markdown:
Protect your customers' web applications with the **SOCFortress WAF**: Caddy + Coraza with the OWASP Core Rule Set v4, a management API and an admin dashboard, run from prebuilt images.

In CoPilot:

- Connect a WAF under **Customers → Customer → WAF**
- Events, stats and threat intel on **Investigate → WAF**
- Block an IP straight from an alert's IoCs
- Forward WAF events into your SIEM, with alerts for blocks and brute force

[Watch the 10-minute demo](https://youtu.be/ZvjfPXP3X30): deploy, automatic TLS, block live attacks, tune a false positive.
